summary: All rounding moved into meterbill/money.py (exact integer arithmetic, no decimal context) and the context line in __init__.py removed; fuzzed CLI output matches the original for bill, batch, quote and tariffs, and tests plus new tests/test_money.py pass. Preserved quirks: batch worker threads used the default half-even context, so batch band charges and per-kWh prices still round half even while bill/quote round half up (keyword-only `rounding` params added); cash 'whole' still never yields a negative zero. Residual risk: arithmetic beyond 28 significant digits now rounds half-even rather than half-up.
